opportunities.theorem: For every 4/9 < v < 1 and 1 < c < 9v/4, there is one complete smooth metric g on R^3, Euclidean near the origin, with Ric(g) >= 0 and AVR(g)=v, such that limsup over integer k tending to infinity of dim H_k(R^3,g)/(k+1)^2 > c. The same g works along an unbounded degree sequence; g may depend on v,c. No endpoint, full-limit, or all-degree lower bound is asserted.
opportunities.problem_connection: The exact Euclidean dimension comparison for polynomial-growth harmonic functions is a question attributed to Yau. The pinned OpenAI Math 3D source announces a degree-by-degree counterexample with a metric g_k that may depend on k. This candidate adds one fixed manifold with recurrent violations and a limsup coefficient approaching the polar-end capacity upper value.
opportunities.why_foundational: It removes the fixed-metric obstruction between degree-dependent examples and one asymptotic geometric object. If N175 and the separately attributed N240 upper are validated, it would show the coefficient 9v/4 is the supremal limsup in the specified three-dimensional polar-end class for v>4/9. It does not newly answer the yes/no Euclidean-comparison question already addressed by the source preprint.

opportunities.mechanism: Fixed-area S^2 angular metrics provide isolated exact double crossings of adjacent eigenvalues. Eigenline continuation cycles a growing spectral band so each label receives the band's mean frequency. A countable schedule concatenates disjoint degree bands in one slowly varying polar metric. Whole-ball harmonic transfer and a countable fixed point match all born-band lines; a concave radial tail preserves Ricci nonnegativity and prescribed AVR. Band separation makes prior dimensions negligible and yields limsup near 9v/4.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: Independently establish the countable whole-ball matching step: one future schedule must solve every newly born band's exact transfer recurrences through all later stages, with one control per mismatch, no duplicate equations, and pointwise growth at every radius. At each crossing, the entire local finite matrix error must be O_n(a_nu), a_nu=eta(t_nu)^(3/4), uniformly over future controls. Separately reconstruct the S1-S3 all-adjacent fixed-area exact-crossing library.
opportunities.early_falsifier: For one fixed born band and one crossing, derive the graph-corrected full local matrix expansion from actual whole-ball maps uniformly over all other controls. If an uncharged off-diagonal term is larger than O_n(a_nu) and reverses one endpoint mismatch sign, the fixed coordinate-box argument fails. Then verify a single stage transition has a finite T_m satisfying all support-comparability, averaging, gap, and envelope inequalities; failure of simultaneous feasibility falsifies the countable schedule.
compatibility_obligations: Check N175 angular family, fixed-area coordinate restoration, all adjacent crossings and isolated-double persistence at the stated source versions.
Check noncircular all-order derivative envelopes, Ricci Schur-complement tail, fixed-cutoff transfer, countable fixed point, birth-band independence, and all-radius pointwise growth.
Verify the candidate lies in N240's entire-exterior polar class before using its 9v/4 upper bound; the underlying Li-Wang primary PDF is absent from the pinned packet and requires external checking.
novelty_boundaries: No endpoint attainment, full limit, or one metric uniform over all v,c.
No implication for arbitrary Ricci-nonnegative manifolds, local conformal flatness, nonnegative sectional curvature, unique tangent cones, or v<=4/9.
No finite metric materialization, numerical spectral certificate, efficient construction cost, formal proof, external correctness review, or priority clearance.

opportunities.theorem: Let n>=3, d=n-1, and let a complete manifold with compact core have global smooth polar end g=dr^2+f(r)^2 h_(log r) on S^d, with proper r, f(r)/r -> a>0, {h_t} precompact in C-infinity, and ||dot h_t||_(C^0(h_t)) -> 0. Set A(t)=Vol(S^d,h_t), K(t)=omega_d a^d A(t)/(2pi)^d, and L=liminf_(T->infinity) T^(-1) integral_(t0)^T K(t)^(-1/d)dt. Then every H_k is finite and limsup h_k/k^d <= ((d+1)/(dL))^d. No limit of A(t), no condition rf'/f -> 1, and no Ricci-sign assumption is required.
opportunities.mechanism: Uniform frozen-cone free-Neumann collar comparison gives a uniform high-index lower bound for scaled Dirichlet-to-Neumann eigenvalues. In the harmonic trace Gram determinant, the radial density derivative integrates exactly to a bounded endpoint term because f(e^t)/e^t -> a; slow angular measure variation contributes o(T). Ky Fan and Hadamard growth then produce the stated averaged capacity bound.
opportunities.load_bearing_missing_lemma: Prove multiplicative Dirichlet-energy and outer-boundary norm comparison for every test function between the actual outer sphere and the frozen-cone collar, uniformly in logarithmic radius, and combine it with a compact-family uniform Weyl law. Pointwise Weyl asymptotics alone do not justify exchanging radius and spectral-index limits.
opportunities.early_falsifier: Check the exact Gram identity and collar comparison for a radial oscillation with f(r)/r -> a but rf'/f nonconvergent, and a slowly varying nonconvergent angular area. A surviving bulk f' term or an angular-measure contribution not o(T) defeats the proposed cancellation.
novelty_boundaries: A polar-end theorem, not a general Ricci-nonnegative or no-foliation theorem.
N240 already attributes a broader 3D fixed-area upper bound to published Li-Wang energy-Gram machinery; N263 contains a neighboring all-dimensional birth-degree budget.
Historical priority and external correctness remain unknown; no named longstanding conjecture is resolved by this statement alone.

rejected_routes.reason: N259 shows rectangular-word separation alone permits a faithful rank-one representation over a rational-function field with rank-two generator matrix. N260's trace-rank inequality blocks the direct finite-characteristic to characteristic-zero group-algebra lift. N261's generalized van Kampen-Flores link obstruction blocks the canonical product-spine PL thickening but does not rule out other realizations. The required compact aspherical five-manifold with pi1 G x F2, or another above-middle L2-Betti construction, remains unconstructed. No concrete mechanism here crosses that gap.
rejected_routes.original_openai_source_boundary: The pinned PD4-no-manifold-model and Singer-dimension-four preprints are separate source claims. Neither supplies the five-dimensional manifold realization required by the N261 conditional route.
